title: GCP Security Ops Engineer
description:
Location: Remote
Start date: ASAP
Languages: English (required)
About The Role
Pragmatike is hiring on behalf of a fast-growing, product-driven AI technology company operating large-scale, cloud-native infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform. The platform is security-critical, highly automated, and designed to support real-time, data-intensive workloads in production environments with strict reliability and compliance requirements.
The engineering organization is lean, senior, and execution-focused. Security is treated as a first-class engineering problem, not a compliance checkbox.
We are looking for a GCP Security Operations Engineer to strengthen day-to-day cloud security operations, hardening, and vulnerability management across production systems. This role is hands-on and close to infrastructure, ideal for engineers who enjoy practical security work, clear ownership, and working directly with cloud-native systems.
What Youll Do
Operate and improve security controls across GCP environments
Perform routine security configuration reviews and implement standard hardening
Work with core GCP security services (IAM, Security Command Center, SecOps, etc.)
Run vulnerability scans, analyze findings, and prioritize remediation
Triage security alerts and provide clear, actionable remediation guidance
Review Python code and system designs for common security issues (auth flaws, injections, misconfigurations)
Document security best practices and contribute to internal security standards
Automate basic security checks and repetitive tasks using scripting
Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to embed security early in the lifecycle
What Were Looking For
Hands-on experience with GCP security services (IAM, SCC, SecOps, logging, policies)
Solid understanding of GCP security best practices and cloud hardening
Practical experience running and interpreting vulnerability scans
Ability to triage security findings and communicate risks clearly
Experience reviewing Python code and system architectures for security issues
Basic scripting skills in Python and/or Bash for automation
Strong operational mindset with attention to detail
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, engineering-led environment
Bonus Points
Experience in AI, data, or high-scale cloud platforms
Prior exposure to regulated or security-sensitive environments
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and automated security checks
French language proficiency
Why This Role Will Pivot Your Career
Work on real-world cloud security problems at scale
Hands-on ownership of GCP security operations in production
Close collaboration with senior infrastructure and platform engineers
Strong exposure to cloud-native security automation
Opportunity to relocate to Dubai with visa and logistics support
Long-term growth in a security-first, product-led organization
Pragmatike is dedicated to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We ensure that no applicant is discriminated against based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely. We collect and use your personal data solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time. We are committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your information throughout the recruitment process.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.

To assist the Head Football Coach in the administration and operation of the football program.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

title: DMS LOG
description:
A DMS Logistics é uma multinacional brasileira de agenciamento de carga, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no comércio exterior e especializada em freight forwarder. Aqui você trabalhará no setor de Technology que é o responsável pelo desenvolvimento, implementação e acompanhamento dos sistemas internos da DMS, além de garantirem sua melhoria contínua e atualizações.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Principais Desafios:
Levantar fluxos de dados entre sistemas com times técnicos e de negócio, mapeando estruturas, formatos (JSON, XML, CSV, etc.), autenticações, dependências e definindo a melhor abordagem de integração (API, RPA, Power Automate, Python, etc.), documentando e versionando;
Desenvolver automações e conectores integrando sistemas como SAP, Oracle, Sapiens, SharePoint e ERPs, criando rotinas Python para tratamentos complexos, integrando prompts de IA generativa e garantindo execução controlada com triggers, jobs, logs e alertas automáticos;
Assegurar que informações cheguem corretamente aos sistemas e à DMS, mantendo compatibilidade de formatos e protocolos (REST, SOAP, OData), implementando autenticação segura (API Key, OAuth, conectores nativos) e apoiando sustentação e troubleshooting de falhas de comunicação;
Monitorar diariamente fluxos automatizados e integrações críticas, corrigir falhas, ajustar lógicas, atualizar automações após mudanças de sistemas internos ou de clientes, gerenciar versionamento, documentação técnica e histórico de execuções;
Identificar gargalos, retrabalhos e oportunidades de automação, propor melhorias e novos fluxos que aumentem eficiência e reduzam erros manuais, além de apoiar times de negócio com dashboards, relatórios técnicos e indicadores de desempenho das automações;
Criar padrões internos de engenharia de prompt, assegurando qualidade, governança, testes, versionamento e integração com Power Automate ou scripts Python.
Requisitos e qualificações
Pré Requisitos:
Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
Inglês intermediário a avançado - será testado;
Experiência com Power Automate, Python, integrações via API, banco de dados e automações de processos;
Conhecimento em engenharia de prompt e uso de modelos de IA generativa;
Experiência com automação em ambientes logísticos ou supply chain;
Experiência com UIPath ou Automation Anywhere;
Familiaridade com SAP, Oracle, Sapiens, SharePoint e Power BI;
Vivência com metodologias ágeis e governança de automações.
Informações adicionais
Na DMS respiramos inovação e somos fascinados por pessoas Aqui temos plano de carreira e gestão do desempenho, com oportunidades reais de crescimento, além dos desafios e possibilidade de colocar em prática seus conhecimentos.
Aqui valorizamos o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, por isso investimos na sua capacitação, proporcionando um ambiente leve, diverso, ágil e colaborativo para você desempenhar as suas tarefas de forma híbrida, flexível e planejada. Não atoa somos uma empresa com certificação GPTW – Great Place To Work

title: pedagogo sae
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.
A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.
A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.
Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.

TITLE: Perinatal Sonographer
CLASSIFICATION: Hourly
HOURS OF WORK: Full Time, 4-day work week
DEPARTMENT: Maternal Fetal Medicine/Perinatology
REPORTS TO: Lead Sonographer, Supervising Physician, Clinic Manager
We seek a dedicated professional with expertise in high-risk obstetric imaging who is deeply committed to excellence in maternal-fetal health. The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative, family-focused environment and values the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient outcomes.
This full-time position offers a four-day work week to support work-life balance while upholding the highest standards of care. Responsibilities include daily sonographic laboratory operations, equipment maintenance and performance, and continuous quality assessment of imaging services. The Perinatal Sonographer upholds strict adherence to Howard University FPP Privacy Policies as well as all applicable federal and state regulations governing healthcare practice and employment.
Essential Duties
Perform all requested sonographic examinations as ordered by the attending physician. Acquire and analyze data obtained using ultrasound and related diagnostic technologies. Meet examination components as defined by Maternal-Fetal Medicine Division, department procedures, established protocols, and AIUM's examination guidelines.
Greet patients and guests, explain ultrasound procedures, prepare patients for appropriate examination according to department policies. Support patients and their families in a compassionate manner.
Verify accuracy of ultrasound requisition by checking physician orders.
Interview patients to gather history pertinent to the ultrasound examination.
Use independent judgment and systematic problem-solving methods to produce high quality diagnostic information and optimize patient care.
Conduct fetal exams including 1st trimester ultrasound, nuchal translucency measurement, 2nd trimester basic and detailed anatomic survey, 3rd trimester ultrasound, limited examinations, follow up examinations, transvaginal examinations, and biophysical profiles.
Assist perinatologists in invasive procedures such as amniocentesis.
Provide summary findings to the physician to aid patient diagnosis and management. Prepare accurate and comprehensive preliminary reports on the Viewpoint system.
Collaborate closely with maternal-fetal medicine physicians, genetic counselors, nurses, and referring providers to ensure comprehensive care.
Perform portable examinations as requested.
Maintain equipment as instructed. Report equipment failures to the Lead Sonographer.
Perform daily pre-visit planning and assign related clerical duties as required.
Work in accordance with FPP and department policies regarding documentation and billing for ultrasound services.
Responsible for room preparation, stocking, clean-up, and equipment sterilization.
Assume responsibility for the safety and well-being of all patients in the sonographic area/department. Monitor, observe and recognize any abnormal changes in patients' conditions and respond appropriately to emergencies with adequate handoff as needed. Obtaining assistance from physicians and other appropriate staff as needed.
Escort patients to a consultation room or waiting area upon completion of sonographic examination.
Coordinate with other staff to ensure appropriate patient care is provided.
Protect Personal Health Information (PHI) and maintaining compliance with Howard University FPP Privacy Policy. Use the minimum PHI necessary when completing assignments.
Adhere to infection control, safety procedures, and HIPAA compliance.
Promote, establish, and maintain open and effective communication with all members of FPP. Serves as a communication liaison between the physician and the patient.
Participate in continuing education and demonstrate critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Receive, organize, prioritize, store, and maintain transmittable information utilizing electronic technology.
Perform other duties as defined by management or physicians.
Education And Experience
Require successful completion of an approved curriculum in diagnostic medical sonography or equivalent educational background.
Current registration (or Registry-eligible) by the American Registry of Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) in Obstetrics and Gynecology.
Prefer one-year prior OB experience or recent internship in obstetrics or MFM clinic. New graduates are welcome to apply.
Basic Life Support and CPR certification are preferred.
Nuchal translucency certification through NTQR or Fetal Maternal Foundation. The ability to obtain certification within 6 months of employment is required if not currently certified.
COMPETENCIES
Exceptional organizational and time management skills to ensure maximum productivity and efficiency.
Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to work with limited supervision while performing duties.
Meet national matrix standards to ensure the provision of high-quality patient care and diagnostic imaging services.
WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS
This job is operated in a professional medical office environment. Requires the ability to work in a fast-paced environment under pressure and with a diverse population including staff, physicians, patients, family, and other members of the public on a regular basis. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. This position will have frequent exposure to contagious diseases; bodily fluids including blood; toxic substances; medicinal preparations and other conditions common to a clinical environment.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
Expected Pay Range: $118,18 - $130,000

title: Drilling Foreman-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking a Drilling Foreman to join Drilling & Workover Operations Department.
Drilling and Workover Operations (D&WOO) is a leading organization whose mission is to drill and work over wells in a safe, efficient, cost effective, and environmentally sound manner. D&WOO operates across a variety of on shore and off shore fields throughout the Kingdom, handling the full spectrum of wells activities including drilling exploration wells, development wells, and work over wells for both oil and gas.
Your primary role is to supervise and coordinate drilling and workover operations at the rig site onshore or offshore to ensure safe, cost-effective, and efficient execution. This includes adherence to Aramco's drilling programs, safety policies, and engineering standards. You will also be accountable for daily operations and rig contractor performance.
Key Responsibilities
As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Ensure proper execution of the drilling/workover program and adapt plans as necessary based on downhole conditions.
Manage safety and environmental compliance, enforce safety practices, and lead pre-job safety meetings (Toolbox Talks).
Investigate, report incidents and implement corrective actions.
Direct all well operations expediently, safely, and according to accepted industry practices as outlined and specified in the well Drilling or Workover program issued by the Drilling Engineering Department.
Coordinate the timely ordering of required well materials, equipment, and services according to the well program.
Document the receipt, usage, and transfer of Saudi Aramco-supplied materials and equipment.
Review service company field tickets for accuracy of services provided and associated charges.
Ensure that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all aspects, including equipment configuration, testing, and crew response.
Ensure that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco's established safety standards and procedures.
Ensure compliance with terms, conditions, and equipment/personnel as specified in the contract on rigs contracted to Saudi Aramco.
Provide management with a complete daily report of work progress as required in the Daily Morning Report.
Promote cost-savings ideas and awareness with a view toward operational optimization consistent with safely meeting well objectives.
Provide on-the-job training to less experienced drilling/workover personnel assigned to the rig.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor Degree in engineering In Petroleum, Chemical, Mechanical or related discipline from an accredited university with a minimum of 7 years of experience in Drilling and workover foreman position including 4 years of experience as a senior foreman.
Or you will have High School certificate with a minimum of 13 years of experience in Drilling and workover foreman position included 4 years as senior foreman
You will be able to handle operational responsibilities on critical wells and demonstrate personnel attributes of sound judgment.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Deve cumprir normas de apresentação pessoal, comunicação cordial e empática, manter rigoroso comportamento ético-profissional, participar dos treinamentos e programas de atualização fornecidos pela instituição e colocar em prática os conhecimentos adquiridos, Realizar o registro de todas as informações no prontuário ou impresso padronizado pela instituição, Solicitar presença do enfermeiro sempre que for necessário, em situações emergenciais ou imprevistas, avaliar antecipadamente a programação cirúrgica, assegurando a disponibilidade de todo o material cirúrgico necessário, Verificar o estoque de material esterilizado, monitorando as datas de esterilização, Receber e orientar pacientes e acompanhantes na admissão, explicando a rotina da unidade, preparar a Sala de Operação com os recursos necessários, Verificar a temperatura da sala cirúrgica, facilitar o transporte e posicionamento do paciente na mesa de cirurgia, preservando sua privacidade e garantindo a permeabilidade de cateteres e sondas, Auxiliar a equipe cirúrgica durante a paramentação e disponibilizar materiais e instrumentais estéreis, garantir o correto posicionamento da placa dispersiva de energia do eletrocautério, Verificar o sistema de gases e auxiliar o anestesista durante a indução e reversão da anestesia, Exercer as funções de circulante de sala, identificar material para exames anatomopatológicos e encaminhá-lo para serviço especializado, com registro adequado, Apoiar o médico neonatologista nos cuidados imediatos do recém-nascido, incluindo a correta identificação com pulseiras e verificação do nome da mãe, Desmontar a sala operatória e encaminhar materiais contaminados ao Centro de Material e Esterilização (CME), solicitar limpeza concorrente ou terminal da Sala de Operação, conforme necessário. title: Data Analyst
description:
About Match Affinity
Match Affinity is a division of Match Group that drives the fastest growing dating apps. Every month, millions of users come to our apps, like BLK and Chispa, to find matches and make great connections.
The Role
As a Data Analyst on our Product Analytics Team, you'll use data to understand our users -- what they need, what they do, how to retain them, and ultimately how to help them find the best dates. Then you will partner with cross-functional teams to provide long-term strategic insights for our products. You will also support business trends/forecasting and model the financial impact of new product ideas.
What You'll Do
A strong knowledge querying massive and complex datasets, analyzing, and driving key and actionable insights
Working with other cross-functional teams like Finance, CRM, Engineering and Business Intelligence; proactively engage other teams to identify and drive better user experience
Providing internal consulting to product management, marketing, finance, and CRM teams on A/B tests as they move initiatives from concept to market
Presenting technical content across business stakeholders
Working as the product owner of revenue and retention strategies for the product
Serving as the subject matter expert on applying various statistical methodologies towards distilling actionable insights
Researching issues about customer behavior/changes by analyzing relevant metrics, trends and supporting enterprise level initiatives
Supporting these products: Chispa, BLK, Upward, Yuzu
You might be a Match if you have:
3+ years of hands on SQL (or structured data) experience along with advanced Excel Skills
Exposure to applied statistics (descriptive statistics, statistical testing, design of experiments, linear modeling, time series analysis etc); Python/SPSS/SAS/R experience a plus
Self-starter with good communications skills
You have experience going beyond number-crunching, reports, and dashboard creation -- you are able to understand the business impact of the data and make recommendations based on your findings
Excellent problem solving skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics,Economics, Computer Science, Engineering related field, Marketing, or MBA with quantitative focus
Experience in product analytics supporting digital applications including mobile apps & consumer internet is preferred
Fluent English is required
Import to know:
As a global company operating across different time zones, flexibility in working hours will be important for this role
Please submit your CV in English

title: Junior Legal Counsel
description:
About Us
GSCF | | Rio de Janeiro – Brazil (Hybrid)
GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring, and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets, and eliminate risk.
Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise, and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world's largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships, and strategic guidance.
Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.
GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.
The role:
The Junior Legal Counsel will work closely with the General Counsel and play a key role in working on Peridot's complex and sophisticated commercial financing business, investment, and other corporate matters to ensure Peridot's legal needs are fully met.
The position is based in Brazil and includes continuous interaction with the General Counsel in New York, and colleagues and business partners located worldwide.
How You Will Make an Impact:
Assist in drafting, reviewing, and supporting negotiating of commercial agreements and legal contracts, including trade financing agreements, loan documents, guarantees, vendor contracts, NDAs, and related financing documents.
Assist with legal entity administration and support corporate governance activities across multiple countries, including helping prepare organizational and compliance filing materials.
Support legal entity administration and maintain compliance record for local operations.
Assist in drafting and reviewing statutory and other corporate documents and provide basic support on corporate law matters under supervision.
Coordinate with internal business and operations including credit, tax, treasury, operations, etc. in connection with legal reviews.
Conduct basic legal research and provide guidance on regulatory requirements applicable to Peridot's business globally.
Correspond with local counsel regarding documentation and team questions and coordinate review by such counsel.
What You Bring to the Team:
Fluent Portuguese, English and Spanish;
Bachelor or university degree in law (or equivalent);
Work experience: 1 year of experience in legal support, contracts or corporate law;
Basic knowledge of contract law and corporate governance;
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail;
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by law.

title: Manual QA Engineer
description:
Join Our Team
Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.
As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.
We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.
About the Role:
We are looking for a QA Analyst (Manual Testing) to ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of web-based applications through thorough manual testing practices. This role is ideal for someone who is who is detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about identifying issues before they reach end-users.
You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle, validating requirements, executing test cases, and clearly documenting findings. The role requires strong communication skills, a solid understanding of QA fundamentals, and the ability to work in dynamic environments where quality and collaboration are critical.
Responsibilities:
Execute manual test cases to validate functionality, usability, and performance
Review requirements and specifications to ensure test coverage
Identify, document, and track defects using bug tracking tools
Perform regression, smoke, and exploratory testing
Collaborate closely with developers and product teams to clarify issues and validate fixes
Ensure testing activities align with the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Maintain clear and accurate testing documentation
Must Have:
Previous experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on manual testing
Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Experience testing web-based applications (mobile testing is a plus)
Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar)
Ability to communicate findings clearly and professionally
Nice to Have:
Experience with mobile application testing
Exposure to basic test case design techniques
Familiarity with Agile or Scrum environments
Interest in expanding toward automation testing in the future

description:

Como Analista de Performance Sênior, você será responsável por promover a gestão de metas corporativas por meio da metodologia de Gestão pelas Diretrizes (GPD), atuando na análise crítica de resultados, identificação de desvios e proposição de ações corretivas, com autonomia e visão integrada para suportar a tomada de decisão das áreas de negócio.

Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Informações adicionais
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)
Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas
Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado
Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.
Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo
Venha fazer parte da PRIO
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único
Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.
Nosso ambiente de trabalho
Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.
Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time

title: Project Manager
description:
Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.
InterMoor is looking to add a Project Manager to the team. The Project Manager's primary responsibility is to plan, direct, and coordinate activities of a single or multiple projects to ensure that goals or objectives of project are safely accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters and the customer receives a quality product or service which meets or exceeds all of the customer requirements.
The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.
**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.
Duties
Plan, direct and coordinate the activities of one or more projects, ensuring that the objectives are achieved safely, within the established deadlines and budget limits
Structure and monitor project budgets, providing revenue and cost analysis, including the appropriate credit releases, as well as participate in the revenue and cost forecast process
Develop and maintain the project schedule with resource allocation, including detailed work breakdown structure (WBS)
Manage projects and assigned teams on a daily basis, including planning operations and supervising operational personnel in the field, reviewing procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation in all phases of the project, ensuring compliance with schedule and budget
Act in the daily monitoring of projects and systems to identify deviations and ensure that activities occur as planned
Propose and implement solutions to mitigate operational downtime or delays that impact the customer or the profitability of the project
Support customers in the elaboration of design concepts and technical specifications
Conduct presentations and support commercial activities
When applicable, coordinate with the Operations and Commercial areas the development of proposals and bids
Review and approve quality plans and technical procedures, as well as develop procedures for subsea projects, when necessary
Analyze proposals and project plans to define deadlines, budget limits, procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation by phase
Define the work plan and the sizing of teams for each phase of the project, informing the personnel needs to the Operations area
Align work plans with project teams, assigning responsibilities, scope, and levels of authority
Direct and coordinate project activities to ensure execution on time and within the approved budget
Review status reports and adjust timelines or plans as needed
Oversee the issuance of requisitions that are not related to general maintenance and repairs, as well as review and approve supplier invoices
Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical and financial reports for management, customers or other stakeholders
Together with Technical Support, provide support to project teams, offering technical guidance and support in solving problems
Review and approve project invoices and support the financial area in matters related to accounts receivable with customers
Carry out national and international trips, as needed
Maintain mandatory training according to management guidelines
Work in close collaboration with the Commercial Department in the analysis of ITTs and submission of proposals, ensuring a well-defined scope, technical skills, necessary equipment and full understanding of terms, conditions and pricing
In coordination with the Commercial area, make presentations to customers about new technologies or solutions that improve their performance
Implement QHSE Management Systems and ensure compliance with local regulations
Verify the compliance of the systems with all Technical, Operational and QHSE bulletins
Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical or financial reports as required by management, customers or other stakeholders
Required
Complete higher education in Engineering, preferably Naval Engineering
Active CREA registration
Desirable post-graduation in a related area
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Desirable good knowledge in Autocad, Office package, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Orcaflex
Desirable experience of at least 8 years in the design and/or installation of permanent anchoring systems for units such as FPSOs, FSOs, FSUs or CALM buoys, among others
Experience in developing offshore operating procedures for subsea installation and/or construction
Good vision and business understanding
Experience in installing flexible and umbilical risers
Expertise in installation analysis
Experience using OrcaFlex software
Experience in developing tenders, including methodologies, schedules, and financial estimates/calculations
Experience in team leadership and team member guidance

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.
You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.
Qualifications
Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
Some experience with MPI programming.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

description:
Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil? Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas. Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco. O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como:segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos. Fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional, zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Atuar na lavanderia, quando disponível, operando máquinas industriais de lavar e secar, além de passar a rouparia dos quartos, uniformes e outros itens, sempre seguindo as recomendações dos fornecedores e as normas de segurança. description:
DESCRIÇÃO
Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil?
Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas.
Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil.
Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível.
Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco.
O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.
Sobre a Oportunidade
Realiza coleta dos materiais nos consultórios para esterilização diária e guarda em lugar específico, para utilização dos profissionais / Dentistas, realiza a Limpeza e higienização dos consultórios, em específico, cadeiras, cuspideiras entre outros itens necessários e pertinentes a atividade; realiza a conferência diária dos equipamentos (consultórios, central de esterilização/ autoclaves) a fim de que estejam em perfeito funcionamento, realizando a comunicação ao responsável imediato das irregularidades, formalizando as solicitações de manutenção junto ao movdesk (ferramenta específica empresa); realiza as atividades em atendimento as regras de segurança do trabalho e garantindo atendimento as normas de fiscalização e vigilância sanitária. Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como: segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos, fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Oportunidade para o Banco Guanabara localizado na Barra da Tijuca - RJ
Conheça mais através do site:
MISSÃO DO CARGO
Assegurar a integridade, a tempestividade e a conformidade das demonstrações contábeis do Banco Guanabara, traduzindo os eventos econômicos em informações confiáveis e relevantes para a gestão e para os órgãos reguladores (Bacen/CMN), apoiando a tomada de decisão da Diretoria e a efetividade dos controles internos, em aderência ao COSIF e às normas CPC/IFRS aplicáveis.
DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES
Executar, revisar e conciliar lançamentos contábeis no sistema, em conformidade com os CPCs, normas do Bacen/CMN e plano de contas COSIF (grupos 1 a 9), assegurando rastreabilidade por meio de controles analíticos e documentação de suporte.
Apurar tributos (ISS, PIS, COFINS, IOF, IRPJ e CSLL), emitir guias de pagamento, realizar conciliações fiscais contábeis e garantir o correto enquadramento tributário.
Constituir, revisar e reverter provisões contábeis (contingências, provisões para perdas, entre outras).
Preparar, validar e transmitir obrigações acessórias (ECD e ECF), assegurando trilhas de auditoria e conciliações com o razão geral e livros auxiliares.
Elaborar e enviar obrigações regulatórias com impacto contábil (ex.: SCR, Doc. 3050, Doc. 4010, entre outras), em alinhamento com as áreas de Riscos, Controles Internos e Negócios.
Atender auditorias internas e externas, organizando PBCs, respondendo aos papéis de trabalho, prestando suporte aos testes e acompanhando recomendações e pontos de melhoria.
Auxiliar na elaboração e revisão das demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DMPL, DFC e Notas Explicativas), garantindo consistência entre saldos, demonstrativos e notas.
Realizar análises gerenciais, elaborar indicadores e relatórios para a Diretoria, propondo ajustes e insights para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Cumprir e zelar pelo cronograma de fechamento contábil, sugerindo melhorias de processos e automações que aumentem a eficiência, a conformidade e a qualidade das informações.
REQUISITOS
Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo.
Conhecimento do COSIF: plano de contas (grupos 1 a 9), natureza, função das contas e conciliações analíticas.
Domínio das obrigações fiscais: apuração e emissão de guias de IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IOF e ISS, bem como conciliações fiscais contábeis.
Experiência com obrigações acessórias: ECD e ECF (validação, cruzamentos e trilhas de auditoria).
Conhecimento em demonstrações financeiras: elaboração e reconciliação de BP, DRE, DMPL, DFC e
Notas Explicativas.

title: Vendedor - LIGAÇÃO - Home Office
description:
Vaga de Vendedor - LIGAÇÃO - Home Office em Rio de Janeiro. R$ 1.500,00 a R$ 3.500,00 (Bruto mensal). Período Integral. Autônomo Área e especialização profissional: Comercial, Vendas - Atendimento Nível hierárquico: Operacional Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro, RJ Regime de contratação de tipo Autônomo Jornada Período Integral Estamos selecionando vendedores(as) por ligação para integrar um time enxuto, estruturado e orientado a performance, atuando em modelo home office, diretamente com leads quentes (clientes que já demonstraram interesse pelo produto).
Esta vaga é EXCLUSIVAMENTE para vendas por ligação.
Não se trata de atendimento por WhatsApp. O WhatsApp é apenas a porta de entrada do lead. O fechamento acontece por telefone, com ligação imediata assim que o cliente demonstra interesse.
O profissional será responsável por ligar para todos os clientes interessados, conduzir a conversa com clareza, esclarecer dúvidas, gerar confiança e realizar o fechamento da venda. Não há prospecção fria. Os leads chegam prontos, e o diferencial da operação está na agilidade e qualidade da ligação.
A atuação ocorre principalmente em horário comercial, das 8h às 17h, em regime home office, exigindo disponibilidade integral e atenção constante aos atendimentos. No entanto, chegam leads também fora desse horário, e atuar nesses momentos é um grande diferencial competitivo, pois quanto mais leads atendidos e mais vendas realizadas, maior é o ganho financeiro. Profissionais focados costumam aproveitar esses atendimentos extras justamente para aumentar significativamente a própria renda.
Os leads devem ser ligados no momento em que entram, sem atrasos. Esta não é uma vaga compatível com outro trabalho simultâneo e não se trata de renda extra. É uma oportunidade para quem busca renda principal, com potencial de ganho elevado.
O trabalho é realizado com nutracêuticos voltados à saúde, especificamente produtos que auxiliam com sintomas relacionados à próstata aumentada. O profissional deve ter maturidade, postura profissional e ausência de constrangimento para falar sobre o tema de forma clara, ética e responsável. Todo o treinamento técnico e comercial será fornecido.
Esta é uma vaga 100% comissionada, sem salário fixo. O modelo de ganho é meritocrático, com comissão escalonada, onde quanto maior o desempenho em vendas por ligação, maior o ganho financeiro. A operação possui alta demanda e clientes interessados diariamente, o que gera potencial real de ganhos elevados para quem executa bem.
Buscamos pessoas com experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente vendas por ligação, sendo considerado um diferencial importante já ter atuado em call center, lidando com alto volume de ligações e metas. É essencial ter resiliência emocional, foco em resultados e capacidade de manter ritmo intenso de chamadas.
Não é uma vaga para quem procura estabilidade, renda complementar ou rotina previsível. É indicada para profissionais que querem fazer das vendas por ligação sua atividade principal, em modelo home office, com foco em resultado, consistência e crescimento financeiro.

title: Corporativo Administrador Operador
description:
Tem vaga nova na área Se você tem interesse em trabalhar no Grupo Habibs, venha cadastrar seu perfil aqui com a gente. Venha fazer parte da maior rede de fast-food genuinamente brasileira. Só vem O que buscamos:Um profissional capaz de garantir a saúde financeira de um conjunto de lojas, a organização dos setores, a gestão de equipe e o cumprimento dos padrões estabelecidos pela franqueadora, promovendo assim, a melhor experiência de consumo aos nossos clientes e assegurando bons resultados ao negócio. Quais serão as suas funções e atividades:Atingir os melhores resultados financeiros da loja por meio da elaboração e acompanhamento do plano de despesas, a fim de reduzir gastos e adequar a alocação de recursos. Garantir que a coluna mestra proporcione uma excelente experiência de consumo aos clientes por meio de um atendimento rápido e cordial e, com bons produtos dentro dos padrões estabelecidos pela Rede. Realizar a gestão e o acompanhamento dos indicadores de resultado e desempenho da loja, buscando ações e soluções que visam o crescimento do TM de cada setor, impactando no aumento de faturamento. Acompanhar controle de estoque da loja, perdas e ganhos dos insumos, vendas qualificadas, visando o resultado final de CMV estabelecido pela Rede. Gerir o fluxo financeiro por meio da administração do capital de giro e das contas a pagar, a fim de manter a saúde financeira da loja. Certificar que as compras estejam em quantidade correta e qualidade adequada, a fim de atender à demanda da loja. Responsável pelo recrutamento e seleção da equipe dos setores cozinha e atendimento. Assegurar que os utensílios, equipamentos e sistemas utilizados estejam em quantidade correta e em bom estado de conservação e funcionamento, providenciando a aquisição, troca ou manutenção, sempre que necessário. Garantir a correta aplicação de recursos nas decisões de investimento, a fim de promover melhorias e adequações aos padrões da franqueadora. Conhecer o cardápio, a composição dos pratos, os acompanhamentos e as campanhas promocionais, buscando atualizações constantes com a Rede e transmitindo os conhecimentos para a equipe de gerência, a fim de garantir o padrão de qualidade de atendimento ao cliente. Assegurar a limpeza e a organização da loja na abertura e fechamento, por meio da equipe de gerência, de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos. Responsabilizar-se pelas obrigações que lhe cabem em relação ao Contrato de Franquia e ao Contrato Social, garantindo a conformidade legal da loja. Realizar a gestão de pessoas da loja, recrutando e selecionando profissionais excelentes, planejando, acompanhando e realizando treinamentos, observando os aspectos motivacionais e do ambiente de trabalho, administrando conflitos, solucionando possíveis problemas e endereçando melhorias, a fim de garantir a produtividade da equipe e contribuição com os resultados da loja. Atuar para que os materiais de marketing estejam expostos na loja de maneira adequada e de acordo com as campanhas vigentes. Também seria legal se você tivesse:Ensino Superior Completo. Experiência com análise de DRE e KPI's de vendas. Conhecimento em finanças e contabilidade. Experiência em gestão de restaurantes, área de operações e/ou sócio proprietário.

title: Sr Customer Enablement Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
The Role
AspenTech is looking for a new Sr Customer Enablement Specialist in Rio de Janeiro. This role will serve as a central coordination hub across multidisciplinary teams including geoscientists, data management professionals, software specialists, and client stakeholders, to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery of Upstream projects using AspenTech's Subsurface Science & Engineering software suites.
This is a high-impact opportunity to directly support one of Aspen Technology's largest and most strategic customers in Latin America while contributing to Aspen Technology's continued growth and success in the region.
Your Impact
Provide loyalty-inspiring customer service that drives user engagement and sustains product usage.
Serve as the primary coordination point between geoscientists, data management teams, software specialists, and customer stakeholders to ensure seamless project delivery aligned with defined scope, schedule, quality, and contractual commitments.
Track and manage project milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies, proactively escalating issues and driving resolution within Aspen Technology.
Facilitate and support project governance activities, including planning sessions, technical workshops, and regular status meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, identifying and communicating potential risks or gaps to management in a timely manner.
Prepare and deliver activity reports, project updates, and status communications to customers and internal management as required.
Provide timely and accurate KPI reporting for operations, financial, and corporate requirements.
Collaborate with other Aspen Technology functions to maintain and develop business opportunities.
Develop strong relationships with Customer, building an understanding of their business needs and operational challenges.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of project coordination practices, delivery workflows, and customer engagement models.
What You'll Need
Bachelor's degree in IT, Engineering, Data Science or Geosciences.
Minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in IT, engineering, data science or geoscience related disciplines. University experience may count.
Experience managing Upstream Data
Experience coordinating Upstream Projects across multidisciplinary technical teams, including geoscientists, data management professionals and software specialists.
Familiarity with methodologies, tools, and best practices for tracking milestones, risks, and deliverables.
Experience creating dashboard and reporting metrics to track project performance and operational KPIs.
Familiarity with data and workflows to support quantitative seismic inversion projects.
Previous experience working on-site with customers is a plus.
Ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner utilizing strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
Ability to proactively take the leads in resolving complex technical issues and/or difficult organisational problems with an innovative approach.
Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.

title: Product Specialist
description:
medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Product Specialist to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview

The Product Specialist acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

title: Drilling Engineer
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Job Overview
We are seeking a Drilling Engineer to join the Gas Drilling Engineering Department.
The Gas Drilling Engineering Department is responsible for providing the development of gas drilling and workover engineering with non-associated gas and highly complex horizontal and vertical gas wells. Identifying and introducing innovations that enhance monitor and support operation and safety.
Your primary role is to gather and analyze information to provide sound drilling technical support to drilling operations, drilling equipment, projects and drilling technical services requiring sound drilling engineering analysis and solutions.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Provides sound drilling engineering methods and procedures to be used on assigned drilling problems.
Executes and accomplishes assignments and studies in areas outlined in the scope assuring conformance to overall objectives of all phases of drilling operations in areas including: drilling penetration rate optimization, new drilling technology and drilling studies.
Provides technical assistance and advice to operating divisions on complex operating problems.
Initiates detailed work outlines and performs or delegates work for final development of technical proposals and studies of proposed.
Analyzes data and performance of new or existing techniques to determine need for or benefit from studies, recommendations and/or facility modifications with respect to unit costs and operating efficiency consistent with established safety and operating requirements.
Minimum Requirements
As the successful candidate you will hold a:
Bachelor's degree in Petroleum, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering or related Engineering discipline from an accredited university.
7+ years of experience in drilling field.
Working environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Why join TCS?
Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.
We are looking for a SAP PMO who wants to learn and transform their career. In this role is responsible for managing the governance, processes, and resources for SAP projects, ensuring successful delivery by overseeing planning, execution, risk management, stakeholder communication, and adherence to methodologies. The SAP PMO ensures that all projects—whether software, infrastructure, or process-related—follow the same methodology, use the same tools, and report indicators in a standardized way, providing consolidated visibility to senior management.
In this role, you will:
• Standardize Methodologies: Define and update the project management "toolkit" (schedule templates, communication plans, risk matrices) to be used by all Project Managers.
• Governance and Compliance: Ensure that projects follow approval phases and internal processes, guaranteeing compliance with company standards.
• Report Consolidation (Dashboards): Gather data from multiple projects to create executive reports on status, timelines, and overall portfolio health (with no focus on costs).
• Resource and Capacity Management (Capacity Planning): Monitor team workload to identify staffing bottlenecks and help prioritize which project should start first.
• Support and Mentorship: Assist Project Managers and Product Owners in resolving methodological conflicts and using management tools.
• Corporate Risk Management: Identify risks that recur across multiple projects and propose structural actions to eliminate them at their source.
• Continuous Improvement: Analyze lessons learned from completed projects to optimize workflows for future cycles.
Required Skills:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, IT, or related fields.
• Previous experience in project management offices (PMO) or leadership roles in process management.
• Exceptional Organization: Ability to structure large volumes of information from different sources.
• Diplomacy and Impartiality: Skill in auditing projects and pointing out deviations constructively and neutrally.
• Analytical Vision: Ability to identify failure patterns in schedules before they become critical issues.
• Teaching Ability: Skill in training others and explaining methodologies in a simple and applicable way.
• Critical Thinking: Ability to challenge current processes in pursuit of simplification and agility (debureaucratization).

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atuar nas atividades relacionadas a gestão de ativos, no controle e melhorias dos ativos de transmissão com 5.239 km de linhas e 61 subestações de 500/230kV, presente em 10 estados. E atuação em ativos de geração com 6 usinas fotovoltaica com 186MW.
Atuar na análise e aprovação na etapa do cadastro do item pelo solicitante no sistema.
Atuar nas etapas do fluxograma do processo de Gestão de estoque.
Atuar na análise, etapas do processo de Calibração e Manutenção dos instrumentos.

Elaborar, automatizar e manter dashboards analíticos e gerenciais em Power BI, contemplando indicadores como: Disponibilidade de ativos, MTTR, MTBF, Backlog crítico, Reincidência de falhas, Perdas energéticas (MWh), Performance e confiabilidade dos ativos;
Criar rotinas de reporte automatizadas, reduzindo esforço manual e aumentando a periodicidade e confiabilidade das análises
Desenvolver modelos analíticos e preditivos utilizando ferramentas de analise de dados, incluindo: Análise de tendência e degradação, Probabilidade de falha, Risco de indisponibilidade, Detecção de anomalias, Apoio à manutenção baseada em condição;

Atuar na modelagem e padronização de dados de ativos, incluindo: Hierarquia e cadastro de ativos, Eventos e ordens de manutenção, Localização, Criticidade e classificação;
Outras atividades delegadas pela coordenação/gerência pertinentes ao cargo.

Conhecimento do Manual de Controle Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico (MCPSE).
Domínio do Pacote Office e Power BI.
Conhecimento em Python ou similar.
Conhecimento em Análise de dados.

Ter atuado no setor de Transmissão de Energia.
Conhecimento em conceitos de confiabilidade.
Conhecimento da ISO 55001.
Experiência na área de Gestão de Ativos.

title: técnico de farmacia
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico.

As a Senior Software Test Engineer, you will bring a solid foundation in test automation tools and strategies, as well as a fundamental understanding of the process of building and deploying software in both cloud and desktop environments. You will use your skills to develop manual and automated tests to validate software functionality.

Evaluate acceptance criteria, determine test approach, write and execute both manual and automated tests as necessary.
Own the testing automation strategy, test data management strategy, and test automation for assigned work.
Maintain existing test automation frameworks for applications for current automation.
Write, debug, and execute code used in both API and UI automated testing efforts.
Define, implement, and manage processes and best practices regarding automated testing.

Provide metrics on business process and code coverage for automated test suites · Present test results to stakeholders.
Recommend improvements to testing processes, technology, and interfaces that improve the effectiveness of testing teams and reduce technical debt.
Lead others on quality-related work; train and mentor team members.
This would make you the ideal candidate
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
6+ Years of experience working in QA and Test Automation roles, with hands-on responsibility for test execution and automation ownership.

Hands-on experience with Selenium and Playwright for UI automation in real-world projects.
Proven experience automating both UI and API tests.
Hands-on experience executing performance and load testing using JMeter.
Experience working in CI/CD environments, such as running automated tests in pipelines and validating releases.
Experience with TypeScript.
Experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day testing workflows.

- Strong analytical skills and advanced use of Excel or Google Sheets.
- Experience creating or maintaining reports, dashboards, or operational metrics.
- Comfort working with structured processes, data validation, and repetitive operational tasks.
- Clear written communication skills and strong attention to detail.
About you
- You are process-oriented and detail-driven.
- You enjoy ensuring things run smoothly behind the scenes.
- You are comfortable working with data, systems, and operational workflows.
- You proactively identify issues and improve processes.
- You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams.

title: Petroleum Economics Principal Analyst, Latin America
description:
About The Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
10
About The Role:
The Petroleum Economics Principal Analyst, Latin America functions as a member of the Vantage Asset Valuation team, providing expert fiscal, economic and financial analysis of upstream assets in Latin America for a wide-ranging customer base. You will become a subject matter expert on oil and gas fiscal modelling, working alongside a global team of experienced researchers and engineers. You will build your knowledge around the wider upstream industry as it, and S&P Global, adapts and evolves with the energy expansion . You'll be a key contact for fiscal research and economic modelling in your region for both internal and external customers.
The Team:
CERA Upstream Solutions at S&P Global Energy comprise some of the most extensive and complete information, analytics, insight, and advisory services in the world. We deliver oil and gas databases and software, energy transition, energy supply and demand forecasts, and comprehensive data on transactions at the global and regional market levels.
Responsibilities And Impact:
Be the go-to individual for fiscal research and economic analysis with thought-provoking, qualitative and quantitative deliverables in the form of excel based models, written reports and presentations. Ensure that the breadth of coverage of Vantage fiscal models covers all types of locations and properties.
Develop stand-alone project level as well as portfolio and company level consolidated cash flow models.
Respond to customer questions of various complexity in assigned geographical regions by providing deep subject matter expertise, timely insight, and good judgement.
Work in close co-operation with colleagues in publishing exciting and timely content.
Collaborate with product management teams to help define what type of results and analysis customers want to see and contribute to the continual development of the Vantage product and its relevant functionality.
Provide expert support to commercial teams, management, and colleagues for the marketing of the Vantage product to contribute to securing and retaining customers.
Continuously develop expertise in a particular practice or focus area and expand knowledge into related fields. Stay abreast of current/hot topics and contribute to written/published products to broaden and build upon subject matter knowledge.
What We're Looking For:
Basic Required Qualifications:
At least a bachelor's degree or studies towards a chartered qualification in economics, finance, tax, accountancy or law is a must. An equivalent combination of experience and education will be considered.
Hands-on experience of constructing, modifying, and reviewing Excel based DCF models (including key financial metrics), ideally of oil and gas upstream and midstream assets.
Experience with / ability to extract fiscal, financial and economic / commercial information from contracts, legislation, etc. and quantify it in the economic models; knowledge of oil and gas upstream fiscal terms / contracts and broader petroleum economics.
Native/Fluent Portuguese Speaker
Additional Preferred Qualifications:
Expert level proficiency in Excel.
Demonstrated proficiency in functional programming (preferably F#), applying best practices, and producing clean, unit‑tested, maintainable code in a collaborative production environment.
Data analytics tools such as SQL, python, R, or other programming languages knowledge is a plus.
Experience in a similar role and with an oil and gas operator, reserves auditor, consulting, advisory or financial institution.
About S&P Global Energy
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.
S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction.
